MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Best of Bread and Carole King Tapestry fit the gentle, melodic mood I associate with listening to Simon & Garfunkel and Melanie.",
    "The Elvis and Neil Diamond collections fit my repeated interest in familiar older songs gathered into best-of albums."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Adele albums do not fit my current wish to revisit older folk and rock favorites, even though I have listened to newer pop before.",
    "Bowie and the large greatest-hits collection interest me, but today I would choose gentler music and a more focused listening experience.",
    "Duets gives me too little information about the performers or songs to connect it to what I enjoy."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My past interest in pop seems to have been taken as a reason to offer Adele, without enough connection to the older songs I want now.",
    "My interest in classic rock collections does not mean every classic rock collection suits my current mood."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The warmth and gentler songwriting connecting Melanie, Simon & Garfunkel, Bread, and Carole King matter more to me today than a broad connection to classic rock.",
    "My recent Christmas listening makes another holiday album worth considering, but I still need to hear whether its songs and performances appeal to me."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my interest in older favorites, but only some captured the gentle, melodic listening mood guiding my choices today."
}
